tldr: 輝達執行長黃仁勳預告新一代 Vera CPU 是台灣供應鏈史上最大規模產品，加上 AMD 蘇姿丰宣布加碼台灣逾百億美元，台灣 AI 硬體鏈成為全球下一輪資本支出震央。
下週同時迎來 MSCI 季調與超級股東會行情，市場估約 2,000 億元買盤進場；ABF 載板、記憶體與 CCL 缺貨延至 2028，PCB、記憶體與 AI 電源族群續創高。
台股太誘人，壽險首季保單解約金額衝上 4,815 億元創高；金管會主委彭金隆視察亞洲資產管理中心高雄專區，並開放專業機構/高淨值法人委任全委投資排除部分限制，財管與資管基礎建設正在改寫。
首季 GDP 暴衝 13.69% 創 39 年新高、4 月失業率 3.3% 為 26 年同期最低；川普稱美伊協議近敲定、荷莫茲海峽將重啟，但外資 3 月狂砍 1,384 億美元美債，總經與資金面同時極端。

items.title_zh: 黃仁勳：Vera 將是台灣供應商史上最大規模產品 台鏈下半年會很忙
items.title_en: Nvidia's Vera CPU will be the largest product ever shipped through Taiwan's supply chain, says Huang
items.summary_zh: 輝達執行長黃仁勳 5 月 23 日在台北活動上表示，全新 Vera CPU 架構將是台灣供應鏈史上規模最大的一款產品，並預告下半年將以「台灣史上最大規模發表會」推出 Vera Rubin。對台積電、日月光、ABF 載板廠與 AI 伺服器代工是強力訂單訊號。
items.summary_en: Speaking at a Taipei event on May 23, Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang said the new Vera CPU architecture will be Nvidia's biggest-ever Taiwan-made product. He warned that the Taiwan AI chain will be "extremely busy" in 2H, with the upcoming Vera Rubin launch billed as "the largest-scale release in Taiwan history" — a strong signal for TSMC, ASE, foundry-grade substrate makers and AI server ODMs.

items.title_zh: 2,000 億買盤下周出閘！MSCI 發威、超級股東會登場 法人口袋名單曝光
items.title_en: MSCI rebalance and "super shareholder-meeting week" set to channel NT$200 billion into Taiwan equities
items.summary_zh: 法人估下周台股將進場約 2,000 億元，因 MSCI 季調生效、加上鴻海、聯發科及主要金控集體召開股東會，內外資聯手鎖定 PCB、低軌衛星及 AI 伺服器族群預先卡位。
items.summary_en: Brokers estimate roughly NT$200 billion in fresh buying will hit Taiwan equities next week as the MSCI quarterly index changes take effect and a heavy cluster of mega-cap AGMs (Foxconn, MediaTek and major financials) opens. Institutions are pre-positioning into PCB, low-orbit-satellite and AI-server names.

items.title_zh: 擠下郭董 國巨董事長陳泰銘躍居台灣首富
items.title_en: Yageo's Pierre Chen overtakes Terry Gou as Taiwan's richest person
items.summary_zh: AI 伺服器與電動車驅動 MLCC 與被動元件價格走揚，國巨董事長陳泰銘身價超車鴻海郭台銘，登上台灣首富，凸顯 AI 資本支出循環正重塑台灣產業大老的財富版圖。
items.summary_en: A surge in MLCC and passive-component prices on the back of AI server and EV demand has pushed Yageo chairman Pierre Chen past Foxconn founder Terry Gou on Taiwan's rich list. The move highlights how the AI capex cycle is reshaping wealth among Taiwan's industrial founders.

items.title_zh: 面板雙虎群創、友達股東常會 談新事業布局
items.title_en: Innolux and AUO AGMs to map out new business; cash dividends of NT$1 and NT$0.4 proposed
items.summary_zh: 群創、友達分別於 5 月 27、28 日召開股東會，將討論每股配發 1 元與 0.4 元的現金股利，並聚焦 FOPLP 與 Micro LED 等轉型布局。儘管配息，法人仍給「中立」評等，主因電視面板供需仍承壓。
items.summary_en: Taiwan's panel duo will hold annual shareholder meetings on May 27 and 28 respectively. Cash dividends of NT$1 (Innolux) and NT$0.4 (AUO) are on the agenda, alongside fan-out panel-level packaging (FOPLP) and Micro LED transition plans. Despite the dividends, brokers keep a "neutral" rating, citing TV-panel oversupply.

items.title_zh: 搶 AI 基建商機！AMD 蘇姿丰加碼台灣逾 100 億美元 鎖定先進封裝、基板、機櫃系統
items.title_en: AMD's Lisa Su commits over US$10 billion to Taiwan, targeting advanced packaging, substrates and rack systems
items.summary_zh: AMD 執行長蘇姿丰來台宣布加碼投資逾 100 億美元，鎖定先進封裝、ABF 載板與整櫃 AI 伺服器，等於把 MI 系列產能基地全面壓在台灣供應鏈。
items.summary_en: Visiting Taipei alongside the Computex week, AMD chair-CEO Lisa Su pledged additional spending of over US$10 billion in Taiwan, focused on advanced packaging (CoWoS-style capacity), ABF substrates and full rack-level AI server systems. The commitment cements Taiwan as AMD's MI series production base.

items.title_zh: ABF 缺很大！今年報價估飆漲 2 成 欣興、南電、景碩準備賺飽飽
items.title_en: ABF substrate shortage to worsen — 2026 ASP seen +20%, Unimicron, Nan Ya PCB and Kinsus to feast
items.summary_zh: ABF 載板供需明顯吃緊，2026 年均價估漲約 2 成，傳輝達將以長約鎖定產能；欣興、南電、景碩為主要受惠者，AI GPU/CPU 需求是核心驅動力。
items.summary_en: Channel checks point to a severe ABF substrate shortage in 2026, with average pricing expected to climb roughly 20% YoY. Nvidia is reportedly negotiating long-term capacity lock-ins. Unimicron, Nan Ya PCB and Kinsus are positioned as primary winners on the back of AI GPU and CPU demand.

items.title_zh: AI 記憶體缺貨恐延續至 2026 年後！美光 CEO：新產能要等到 2028
items.title_en: Micron CEO: AI-driven memory shortage to extend past 2026; new capacity not online until 2028
items.summary_zh: 美光執行長馬羅特拉表示，AI 浪潮將使 DRAM 與 HBM 供不應求延續至 2026 年後，公司在美擴產 2,000 億美元，新產能最快 2028 年才會大量上線，美國產能佔比目標由 10% 拉升至 40%。
items.summary_en: Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra said AI demand will keep DRAM and HBM in chronic shortage well beyond 2026, with the company's US$200 billion US capacity expansion not delivering meaningful output until around 2028. Micron is targeting 40% US-based production share, up from 10% today.

items.title_zh: 蘇姿丰看好 AI PC 爆發！高速傳輸需求大升級 法人點名 2 台廠最受惠
items.title_en: Lisa Su upbeat on AI PC explosion — two Taiwan high-speed-interconnect plays flagged
items.summary_zh: 蘇姿丰預期 AI PC 將大幅升級高速傳輸需求，法人點名兩家台灣高速介面/傳輸晶片廠最受惠，下半年 ASP 拉升動能將更明確。
items.summary_en: At her Taipei briefing, Su forecast that AI PCs will require significantly upgraded high-speed transmission, naming two Taiwanese suppliers (signal-chain and PCIe / Type-C interconnect players) as primary beneficiaries. Brokers see AI-PC ASP uplift accelerating into 2H.

items.title_zh: 台積電壓力來了？三星罷工剛平息 李在鎔直奔台灣訪聯發科 背後盤算曝光
items.title_en: Samsung's Lee Jae-yong flies to Taiwan to meet MediaTek — fresh competitive pressure on TSMC
items.summary_zh: 三星罷工才剛落幕，會長李在鎔旋即訪台拜會聯發科，市場揣測雙方可能在三星先進製程委外與行動 AP 合作上進一步靠攏，對台積電構成新一波競爭壓力。
items.summary_en: Days after settling its memory strike, Samsung chair Lee Jae-yong made an unannounced trip to Taiwan to meet MediaTek, fuelling speculation over a Samsung foundry node win and a possible mobile AP partnership pivot. Analysts read it as a clear competitive shot across TSMC's bow.

items.title_zh: 輝達單季豪砸 186 億美元 富養 AI 生態圈 受惠企業一次看
items.title_en: Nvidia plowed US$18.6 billion into AI-ecosystem investments in a single quarter
items.summary_zh: Marketwatch 報導，輝達單季投入 186 億美元創投與私募投資，從晶片供應商升級為 AI 生態圈推手；CoreWeave、Lambda、Wayve 及多家人形機器人與 AI 基建新創同時是其客戶，形成飛輪效應。
items.summary_en: Marketwatch reports Nvidia deployed US$18.6 billion of capital into venture and private-company stakes in a single quarter, underscoring its evolving role from chip vendor to AI ecosystem patron. Direct beneficiaries include CoreWeave, Lambda, Wayve and several humanoid-robot and AI-infrastructure start-ups, many of which are also Nvidia customers.

items.title_zh: 投資美國融資保證首案 八大行庫出資 3.5 億美元
items.title_en: First "Invest-in-America" loan guarantee case lands — eight state-controlled banks syndicate US$350 million
items.summary_zh: 路透指出，「投資美國融資保證」首案浮現，八大公股行庫聯合融資 3.5 億美元，傳由台灣中油承貸，計畫在休士頓既有土地興建「TAIWAN TOWER」商辦，為台廠赴美設廠融資打開新範本。
items.summary_en: Reuters reports that Taiwan's first deal under the "Invest in America" financing-guarantee programme has surfaced, with eight state-controlled banks jointly committing US$350 million. CPC Corp is said to be the borrower, planning to build "Taiwan Tower" — an office complex in Houston — on existing land. The deal sets a template for Taiwan corporates' US capex funding.

items.title_zh: 油價推升聯準會升息機率 富邦、國泰金法說 市場聚焦五議題
items.title_en: Fubon FHC and Cathay FHC Q1 results in focus — five hot topics including IFRS 17 first-year impact
items.summary_zh: 富邦金、國泰金將於 5 月 25、29 日舉行第 1 季法說會，市場聚焦五大議題：壽險首年接軌 IFRS 17 與新清償制度、避險成本、台股投資收益、外匯準備金動用節奏，以及 2026 年股利政策。
items.summary_en: Fubon Financial and Cathay Financial will hold their Q1 investor conferences on May 25 and 29 respectively. The market will focus on five themes: IFRS 17 / TW-ICS first-year results, hedging costs, equity-investment gains from a strong TWSE, life FX-reserve usage, and dividend guidance for 2026.

items.title_zh: 路透：央行安排企業買匯
items.title_en: CBC quietly arranges corporate FX purchases — Reuters
items.summary_zh: 路透引述消息來源指出，台灣央行近期透過安排企業（以公股事業為主）進場買匯，減緩新台幣升值速度；5/22 台幣以 31.568 元收盤，本周預估 31.4~31.7 元區間整理。
items.summary_en: Reuters reports Taiwan's central bank has been quietly arranging corporates (notably state-owned enterprises) to buy USD in the spot market to slow the pace of the NT dollar's appreciation, with the TWD closing at 31.568 on May 22. Brokers see TWD trading in a 31.4–31.7 band this week.

items.title_zh: 金管會督導期交所規劃國外成分證券 ETF 期貨及選擇權採三階段漲跌幅機制
items.title_en: FSC unveils tiered limit-up/down mechanism for ETF futures and options on foreign-listed underlyings
items.summary_zh: 金管會督導期交所，針對追蹤國外成分證券的 ETF 期貨與選擇權，將採三階段漲跌幅機制，使衍生性商品風控與境外標的波動接軌，制度將分階段上路。
items.summary_en: The FSC has instructed TAIFEX to roll out a three-stage price-limit mechanism for futures and options based on ETFs tracking foreign-listed constituents, aligning derivative risk-management with the higher volatility of overseas underlyings. The framework will be phased in over three stages.

items.title_zh: 五大銀行房貸動能降溫
items.title_en: Mortgage momentum at the top-five banks cools off
items.summary_zh: 五大行庫 4 月新承做房貸動能轉弱，反映央行選擇性信用管制效應持續發酵與房市放緩；公股行庫首季房貸餘額微增，靠首購自住剛需支撐。
items.summary_en: New mortgage drawdowns at the five largest mortgage banks (Taiwan Coop, Land Bank, First Bank, Hua Nan and Mega) lost momentum in April, reflecting the lagged impact of the central bank's selective credit controls and a slowing housing market. Public-bank Q1 mortgage book grew only marginally, supported mainly by first-time-buyer demand.

items.title_zh: 彭主任委員視察亞洲資產管理中心高雄資產管理專區
items.title_en: FSC chair Peng inspects Kaohsiung's Asset Management Pilot Zone
items.summary_zh: 金管會主委彭金隆視察「亞洲資產管理中心」高雄資產管理專區，凸顯政策力挺南台灣家族辦公室、信託與高資產財管布局，作為台北專區的南向延伸。
items.summary_en: FSC chairman Peng Chin-lung visited the Kaohsiung Asset Management Pilot Zone, the southern node of Taiwan's Asia Asset Management Centre initiative. The visit underscores policy momentum behind family office, trust and HNW services in Kaohsiung as a complement to the Taipei zone.

items.title_zh: 全權委託投資業者接受專業投資機構或高淨值投資法人委託且同意 排除部分運用限制
items.title_en: FSC eases discretionary-investment rules for pro institutions and HNW corporates
items.summary_zh: 金管會同意全委投資業者在受託專業機構或高淨值法人並取得書面同意時，可排除部分委託投資資產運用限制，為私行、高資產與家族辦公室全委型專戶鬆綁。
items.summary_en: The FSC has agreed to allow discretionary investment managers, when mandated by professional institutional investors or high-net-worth investor corporates that consent in writing, to be exempt from certain restrictions on the use of mandated assets. The change is a meaningful enabler for private-bank, HNW and family-office discretionary mandates.

items.title_zh: 台股誘人 引爆保單解約潮 壽險第 1 季相關金額達 4,815 億元
items.title_en: Insurance policy surrenders explode to NT$481.5 billion in Q1 as savers chase Taiwan equities
items.summary_zh: 壽險業首季保單解約相關金額飆至 4,815 億元，民眾轉錢進台股；壽險負債基礎縮水、IFRS 17 下資產負債管理難度上升，將是國泰、富邦金法說重要議題。
items.summary_en: Life-insurance-related surrender amounts hit NT$481.5 billion in Q1, with policyholders redeploying cash into a record-breaking TWSE. The shift squeezes life insurers' liability base, accelerates ALM repositioning under IFRS 17, and is now a key topic for upcoming Cathay and Fubon investor days.

items.title_zh: 八大壽險保價金差額衝高 配息大補丸
items.title_en: Top eight life insurers' policy-value-vs-reserve gap widens, fattening dividend potential
items.summary_zh: 八大壽險「保單價值準備金」與「解約金」差額再放大，使壽險實現投資收益空間擴張，金控母公司 2026 年現金股利可分配額度同步加大，是金控配息的「大補丸」。
items.summary_en: Spread between policy reserves and surrender values at the top eight life insurers widened further, creating fatter realised investment gains and additional cash dividend headroom for parent FHCs in 2026 — a meaningful tailwind for FHC payout ratios.

items.title_zh: 勞退自提大增逼近 120 萬人 九成勞工選擇提滿 6% 製造業參與最踴躍
items.title_en: Labour-pension voluntary contributions near 1.2 million participants — 90% maxing out at 6%
items.summary_zh: 勞動部統計，2024 年勞退自提人數逼近 120 萬人、占比 15.59% 雙寫歷年新高，且九成提滿 6%，製造業參與最踴躍；反映節稅意識升溫，亦擴大第三支柱財管商品的潛在客群。
items.summary_en: Per Ministry of Labour data, voluntary contributions to the Labour Pension scheme in 2024 reached nearly 1.2 million participants (15.59% participation rate, both record highs); about 90% are contributing the maximum 6%. Manufacturing sector workers lead. The trend signals rising tax-shelter awareness and a fatter pillar-3 base for wealth-management product distribution.

items.title_zh: 每月 5,000 元一半存 TISA？卓揆：擬修法設保底「包贏」機制
items.title_en: Premier Cho: TISA reform to add a "guaranteed-win" floor mechanism — NT$5,000/month proposal under review
items.summary_zh: 行政院長卓榮泰表示，政府研擬修法讓 TISA（台版個人儲蓄帳戶）每月 5,000 元有一半納入保底「包贏」機制，回應民眾對下行風險疑慮，商品結構、稅務優惠與額度仍跨部會研議。
items.summary_en: Premier Cho Jung-tai said the government is considering legislative tweaks to TISA (Taiwan Individual Savings Account) so that a portion of the NT$5,000/month contribution is parked in a "guaranteed-win" floor product, addressing public concern over downside risk. Detailed product structure, tax wrapper and limit design are still under inter-agency review.

items.title_zh: 6 月起這些公教人員年金給付率調高至 6.46％
items.title_en: Public-sector pension payout ratio rises to 6.46% from June
items.summary_zh: 自 2026 年 6 月起，部分軍公教人員年金給付率調高至 6.46%，較年改後水準回升，影響退休所得規劃、補強型年金商品設計，以及退休基金的匯率與存續期需求。
items.summary_en: Effective June 2026, pension payout ratios for certain categories of military, civil-servant and public-school personnel will be raised to 6.46%, a meaningful rebound from prior reform-era cuts. The adjustment matters for retirement income planning, supplementary-annuity product positioning, and pension-related FX/duration demand.

items.title_zh: 報稅季倒數 華南永昌證揭投資節稅攻略
items.title_en: Final stretch of tax-filing season — Hua Nan Yongchang Securities flags investment tax-planning playbook
items.summary_zh: 報稅季倒數，華南永昌證券公布投資節稅攻略，涵蓋股利分離課稅 28% 選擇、海外所得申報及最低稅負門檻，提供高資產客戶完成 2025 年度申報的實務提醒。
items.summary_en: As the May tax-filing window closes, Hua Nan Yongchang Securities publishes its investment tax-planning checklist, covering separate-tax treatment of dividends, the 28% optional rate, foreign-source income reporting and the AMT threshold. Practical reminders for HNW investors completing 2025 filings.

items.title_zh: 國發會：第 1 季經濟成長率衝上 13.69％ 創 39 年紀錄
items.title_en: Q1 GDP surges +13.69% YoY — fastest in 39 years
items.summary_zh: 國發會證實，台灣 2026 年第 1 季實質 GDP 年增 13.69%，為 39 年來最強單季表現，半導體與資通訊出口為主要動力；全年「坐七望八」，主計總處 5/29 公布最新預測。
items.summary_en: The National Development Council confirmed that Taiwan's Q1 2026 real GDP expanded 13.69% YoY, the strongest quarterly print in 39 years, driven by semiconductor and ICT export momentum. Full-year forecast tracking points to "approaching 8%" growth, with the DGBAS official update due May 29.

items.title_zh: 4 月失業率降至 3.3% 寫 26 年來同月最低
items.title_en: April unemployment rate 3.3% — lowest April reading in 26 years
items.summary_zh: 主計總處公布 4 月失業率 3.3%，創 26 年同期最低，年後轉職族迅速找到工作，配合 GDP 強勁，強化央行「無須急著降息」的政策論述。
items.summary_en: DGBAS reported April unemployment at 3.3%, the lowest April level in 26 years, with post-Lunar-New-Year job-switchers absorbed quickly. Combined with the GDP print, the labour market reinforces a "no rush to cut" narrative and complicates any future easing case.

items.title_zh: 半導體、資通訊業強勢帶動 今年經濟成長坐七望八
items.title_en: Semis and ICT power Taiwan growth — "approaching 8%" upgrade in sight
items.summary_zh: 主計總處 5/29 將更新預測，券商預期 2026 全年 GDP 由「保 7」上修至「坐七望八」，半導體與資通訊出口為核心；對台幣與台股資金面正向，但過熱風險升溫。
items.summary_en: Ahead of the May 29 DGBAS update, sell-side desks see 2026 full-year GDP growth being lifted from "around 7%" to "approaching 8%" on the back of semis and ICT export surprise. Strong upgrade momentum supports TWD and equity flows but raises overheating concerns.

items.title_zh: 川普稱美伊核談判「接近達成協議」 預告荷莫茲海峽將重新開放
items.title_en: Trump: US–Iran nuclear deal "close to done" — Strait of Hormuz set to reopen
items.summary_zh: 川普 5/23 表示美伊核協議「大致談妥」，內容包含重新開放荷莫茲海峽，近期將公布細節，但若無「理想協議」仍不排除恢復軍事行動；油市開始反映供給風險溢價回吐。
items.summary_en: President Trump said on May 23 that the US-Iran nuclear agreement is "substantially negotiated" and that an announcement is imminent, including a reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. He simultaneously warned that military options remain on the table if a final deal slips. Oil markets are now pricing a meaningful supply-risk premium reversal.

items.title_zh: 美國 5 月消費者信心創歷史新低 通膨預期持續上升
items.title_en: US May consumer confidence prints all-time low; inflation expectations climb
items.summary_zh: 5 月密大消費者信心指數創歷史新低，1 年期通膨預期續升，反映伊朗戰事推升油價、關稅疑慮與生活成本壓力；對華許接任聯準會主席後的政策路徑形成額外干擾。
items.summary_en: University of Michigan's May consumer-sentiment index fell to a historical low while 1-year inflation expectations rose further, reflecting Iran-conflict-driven energy worries, tariff anxieties and persistent cost-of-living strain. The print complicates the Fed's transition under new chair Kevin Warsh.

items.title_zh: 外資單月狂賣 1384 億美元美債！市場押注 Fed 年內升息機率逼近 70%
items.title_en: Foreigners dump record US$138.4 billion of US Treasuries in March; markets price ~70% chance of Fed hike this year
items.summary_zh: 美財政部 TIC 數據顯示 3 月外資減持美債 1,384 億美元創新高，日本、中國、土耳其領跌；長天期殖利率飆升、債市熊式陡峭化，市場押注 Fed 新主席華許上任後年內升息機率近 70%。
items.summary_en: US Treasury TIC data show foreign investors offloaded a record US$138.4 billion of Treasuries in March, led by Japan, China and Turkey. With long-end yields spiking and the bear steepener accelerating, futures markets now imply a ~70% probability of at least one Fed hike during chair-elect Kevin Warsh's first year.

items.title_zh: 美股危險了？美銀「牛熊指標」亮紅燈！觸發「反向賣出」訊號
items.title_en: BofA "Bull & Bear" indicator triggers contrarian sell signal — first since 2002 family of warnings
items.summary_zh: 美銀牛熊指標升至 8.0，觸發 2002 年以來第 17 次反向賣出訊號；報告指 AI Big 10 集中度已超越歷史所有泡沫高峰，未來數月全球股市面臨修正壓力。
items.summary_en: Bank of America's flow report shows the Bull & Bear indicator has risen to 8.0, triggering a contrarian "sell" signal — the 17th since 2002. BofA warns AI Big-10 concentration exceeds prior bubble peaks and that global equities face downside risk in coming months.

items.title_zh: SpaceX 上市散戶恐成接盤俠！私募資金恐高位套現、歷史數據揭「這時候」買賺最多
items.title_en: SpaceX IPO at ~US$2T may leave retail holding the bag — academic data warn against mega-IPOs
items.summary_zh: 路透指 SpaceX 將以近 2 兆美元估值 IPO，OpenAI、Anthropic 緊接其後；歷史數據顯示超大型 IPO 長期常跑輸大盤，私募投資人趁高出脫、指數型基金與散戶被動承接。
items.summary_en: SpaceX is reportedly preparing an IPO at close to US$2 trillion valuation, with OpenAI and Anthropic to follow. Historical analysis cited by Cnyes warns that mega-IPOs tend to underperform the broader market long term as private holders cash out at the top and passive funds / retail investors absorb the supply.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 營收爆發成長！傳估值直逼 1 兆美元 拿下全球最貴 AI 新創寶座
items.title_en: Anthropic revenue ramp accelerates; valuation reportedly nears US$1 trillion
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 因營收爆發成長，傳估值將逼近 1 兆美元，有望成為全球最貴 AI 新創；同步強化美銀、Hartnett 等示警的 AI 集中度風險。
items.summary_en: Anthropic is reported to be in talks at a valuation approaching US$1 trillion on the back of explosive revenue growth, potentially making it the most valuable private AI start-up globally. The print further cements concentration risk in AI mega-caps that BofA, Hartnett and Das are flagging.
